title: Execution Tasks
assumptions: This plan covers only `backend/` front-end assets and templates; `extension/` remains untouched.
Existing Django template/static roots stay unchanged, and refactor work is limited to introducing `layouts/`, `pages/`, and `components/` sub-structure under current roots.
Existing route URLs, views, form POST targets, auth/ownership checks, and API endpoints are preserved; this is a structural refactor with behavioral parity.

Current user-facing pages in scope include `home`, all `accounts` auth templates, and `clips` pages (`list`, `detail`, `labels`) with current interactions (theme toggle, quick search, filters, delete flow, label form flows).
Validation commands from the spec are treated as mandatory completion gates (`make backend-test-unit`, `make backend-lint`, `make backend-typecheck`, and `make all-verify` before handoff).

tasks.description: Establish migration inventory and target modular map for every current backend template/static asset, including route-to-page mapping and interaction ownership boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: A checked-in migration matrix lists each existing template and asset with its target destination (`layouts`, `pages`, `components`, `js/pages`, `js/components`, `css/components`, global `tokens/base`).
Every route/page in scope is mapped to exactly one page entrypoint under `templates/.../pages/`.
Every existing interaction (theme toggle, quick search, filters, delete clip, labels CRUD forms, auth forms) is assigned to page-level orchestration or component-level ownership.
notes: Treat this as the source of truth for batch migration sequencing and parity verification.

tasks.description: Create global modular scaffold under `backend/webclippings/templates` and `backend/static` (layouts/components, design tokens, and component/page JS/CSS directories) without behavior changes.
acceptance_criteria: Global directories exist per spec (`templates/layouts`, `templates/components`, `static/js/components`, `static/css/components`, `static/css/tokens.css`).
`tokens.css` and global `base.css` loading order is defined and applied consistently.
No runtime regressions occur from scaffold introduction alone.
notes: Keep root paths unchanged; do not migrate Django `settings.py` template/static configuration in this phase.

tasks.description: Modularize global base shell into explicit layout and reusable global components, and remove inline JS/CSS from migrated templates.
acceptance_criteria: `base.html` responsibilities are split into layout + included global components (for example nav, footer, theme toggle control, authenticated quick-search shell) using `{% include %}`.
Migrated templates contain no inline `<script>` or `<style>` blocks/attributes requiring dedicated component CSS/JS extraction.
Each new component template includes the required header contract comment (`component`, `inputs`, `actions`).
notes: Keep `{% extends %}` only for page-to-layout inheritance; components must not extend templates.

tasks.description: Introduce app-level modular structure for `clips` and `accounts` templates/static assets and move existing pages into `pages/` with app layouts/components directories.
acceptance_criteria: `backend/apps/clips/templates/clips/pages`, `components`, `layouts` and `backend/apps/clips/static/clips/js/components`, `js/pages`, `css/components` exist and are wired.
`backend/apps/accounts/templates/accounts/pages`, `components`, `layouts` exist and auth templates are migrated to page files.
All migrated pages render from `pages/` paths with no route breakage.
notes: Use component naming triplets with matching kebab-case base names.

tasks.description: Decompose clips list page template into focused reusable components with explicit input contracts and include-context usage.
acceptance_criteria: `clips` list page is split into page template + component partials (filter sidebar, filter drawer, selected filters/pills, clip card/list item, empty states).
Component include call sites pass explicit context via `with`; no hidden ambient variable dependencies beyond documented contracts.
Rendered UI structure and visible behavior for list route remains parity-equivalent.
notes: Keep one component per responsibility; avoid oversized partials that mix unrelated concerns.

tasks.description: Split clips list JavaScript into page entrypoint orchestration plus component-scoped modules using stable `data-component` ownership boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Current `clips/static/clips/js/list.js` logic is partitioned into `js/pages/<page>.js` (page orchestration) and `js/components/<component>.js` modules.
Component JS only reads/mutates DOM within `[data-component="<component-name>"]` roots.
Cross-component coordination uses DOM events and/or URL/query state, avoiding tight direct imports where possible.
notes: Preserve current keyboard and accessibility behavior for quick-search and filter controls.

tasks.description: Decompose clips list CSS into component-scoped styles and move shared constants to tokens/base layers.
acceptance_criteria: Existing `clips/static/clips/css/list.css` rules are split by component into `css/components/<component>.css` files.
Component styles are scoped via root class or `[data-component="<component-name>"]` selectors and avoid global element overrides.
Any shared visual constants are promoted to `static/css/tokens.css` (and referenced from component styles/base).
notes: Preserve responsive behavior and no-horizontal-scroll constraints on clips list layouts.

tasks.description: Modularize remaining clips pages (`detail`, `labels`) into page/component architecture and externalize any inline styling to scoped CSS components.
acceptance_criteria: `clips/detail` and `clips/labels` templates are moved under `templates/clips/pages/` and decomposed into reusable components where beneficial.
Inline style currently present in clips detail content block is removed and represented in component/base CSS.
Labels create/update/delete forms and detail label editing workflows preserve current behavior and permissions.
notes: Keep forms server-rendered and progressively enhanced only where needed.

tasks.description: Modularize accounts and home UI templates into page/component/layout structure while preserving current auth UX and form behavior.
acceptance_criteria: All accounts templates (login/register/password reset/activation flows) are represented as page templates under `templates/accounts/pages/` with reusable components for repeated auth-card/form patterns.
`home` page is migrated to page/component structure and continues to render authenticated/anonymous CTAs correctly.
No auth flow regressions (sign-in, register, password reset, activation) are introduced.
notes: Keep messaging and validation/error rendering parity with existing templates.

tasks.description: Add automated and manual parity verification coverage for migrated routes/components, including regression tests for clips ownership-sensitive behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Automated tests are added/updated for any behavior affected by template/JS refactor, especially clips list interactions and auth-sensitive clips access.
notes: Keep test changes focused on behavior; avoid overfitting to internal template structure.

tasks.description: Run required quality gates and finalize compliance documentation for handoff.
acceptance_criteria: `make backend-test-unit`, `make backend-lint`, and `make backend-typecheck` pass for migration batches.
`make all-verify` passes before handoff.
Plan artifacts are updated with final status/progress and any intentionally deferred debt is captured in `docs/TECH_DEBT_BACKLOG.md`.
notes: Treat any failing gate as a blocker; do not hand off without resolution or explicit documented defer decision.

tasks.description: Replace component CSS selector coupling with explicit BEM class contracts for all currently styled components.
acceptance_criteria: Component CSS no longer uses `[data-component="..."]` selectors as the styling anchor.
Component CSS selectors use explicit BEM block/element/modifier class names.
Component CSS selectors do not rely on ids or tag-based selectors for component styling.
Styled component roots expose one canonical BEM block class each.

tasks.description: Align component templates with BEM root/element/modifier classes to match migrated CSS contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Templates for styled components include canonical BEM root classes on component roots.
Element class names in templates follow `<block>__<element>` where component styles target them.
Modifier classes follow `<block>--<modifier>` or `<block>__<element>--<modifier>` and are always paired with their base class.
`data-*` attributes remain available for JavaScript hooks but are not required for CSS targeting.

tasks.description: Update JavaScript class/state handling to use BEM modifiers and preserve interaction parity after template/CSS class migration.
acceptance_criteria: JS toggles BEM modifier classes instead of legacy state classes (for example `is-collapsed`, `.active`, `is-selected`) where those classes are component styling state.
Component JS keeps using `data-*` selectors for ownership/behavior hooks.
Existing clips list interactions keep parity (filter panel toggle, drawer open/close, selected labels behavior, quick search keyboard navigation, delete flow).

tasks.description: Extend component header contracts to include BEM metadata (`block`, `elements`, `modifiers`) across migrated component templates.
acceptance_criteria: Every migrated component template header includes `component`, `inputs`, `actions`, `block`, `elements`, and `modifiers`.
Header metadata reflects the actual class contract used in template/CSS.

tasks.description: Re-run verification and manual BEM compliance checks for migrated routes/components.
notes: Include desktop/mobile sanity and browser console error checks for each migrated route.

tasks.description: Align clips list JS component module naming and ownership boundaries with template component naming triplets.
acceptance_criteria: Clips list component JS files use basenames that match their corresponding template component names and responsibilities.

Reusable component behavior is implemented in `backend/apps/clips/static/clips/js/components/<component-name>.js`; page orchestration remains in `backend/apps/clips/static/clips/js/pages/list-page.js`.
`backend/apps/clips/templates/clips/pages/list.html` script includes/import usage reflect the renamed/split modules without stale references.
Existing clips list interactions (filtering, selected labels operations, clip delete flow) remain parity-equivalent after module alignment.
notes: Address review finding `ISSUE-01` from `docs/plans/modular-front-end/pr62-review-findings.md`.

tasks.description: Refactor component JS initialization to be rooted per component instance instead of document-global selectors.
acceptance_criteria: `backend/apps/clips/static/clips/js/components/clip-card.js` initializes from component roots and only queries descendants within each root.
`backend/apps/clips/static/clips/js/components/label-filter-options.js` initializes from explicit component roots and removes broad document/root selection during setup.
`backend/static/js/components/global-auth-quick-search.js` initializes quick-search behavior from its component root instead of global ID-only lookup.
Cross-component behavior remains orchestrated at page-entrypoint level, and component modules maintain encapsulated ownership boundaries.
notes: Address review finding `ISSUE-02` from `docs/plans/modular-front-end/pr62-review-findings.md`.

tasks.description: Add regression coverage and re-run verification after PR #62 review fixes.
acceptance_criteria: Automated coverage is added/updated for any behavior touched by T017-T018, including multi-instance/component-root initialization paths.
notes: Keep validation focused on behavioral parity and modular ownership guarantees.

tasks.description: Restore CSRF context propagation for labels page form components included with `{% include ... only %}`.
acceptance_criteria: `backend/apps/clips/templates/clips/pages/labels.html` passes `csrf_token` explicitly to each included partial that renders POST forms while using `only`.
Include chains used by labels create/update/delete forms preserve CSRF token rendering in browser requests.
Labels create/update/delete POST flows no longer fail CSRF validation due to missing token context.

tasks.description: Forward CSRF context to clip detail labels panel include to keep label edit POSTs valid.
acceptance_criteria: `backend/apps/clips/templates/clips/pages/detail.html` passes `csrf_token` to the `detail-labels-panel` include when using `only`.
`backend/apps/clips/templates/clips/components/detail-labels-panel.html` renders a valid CSRF hidden input on POST forms in real browser responses.
Label edit/save flow on clip detail no longer fails with CSRF 403 caused by include context isolation.

tasks.description: Add CSRF regression coverage for labels/detail form partial includes and re-run required quality gates.
acceptance_criteria: Automated tests are added or updated to cover labels page and detail page POST form flows that depend on CSRF token rendering through include chains.
notes: Validate both template render output (token present) and behavior-level POST success for authenticated owners.

tasks.description: Canonicalize component root contracts and remove redundant root-level aliases.
notes: Migrated from `docs/plans/modular-front-end/code-review-findings.md` task `CRF-001`.
Reconfirm there are no remaining direct consumers of removed root aliases before deletion.

tasks.description: Remove unused non-root hooks and eliminate CSS styling coupled to `data-*` attributes.
acceptance_criteria: Unused non-root hooks are removed where there are no active JS/CSS/test consumers (`data-results-region`, `data-selected-labels`, `data-drawer-clear-all`, `data-visible-limit`, `data-label-empty-state`).
CSS selectors that target `data-*` hooks are replaced with canonical class-based BEM selectors.

Actively used interaction hooks remain intact (`data-action="clear-label-filters"`, `data-filter-drawer-trigger`, `data-filter-drawer-close`, `data-filter-panel-toggle`, and label toggle/search hooks).
Affected tests are updated only as needed for removed hook assertions.
notes: Migrated from `docs/plans/modular-front-end/code-review-findings.md` task `CRF-002`.
Reconfirm zero usage across JS/CSS/tests before deleting each hook.

tasks.description: Refactor clips list JS ownership boundaries by moving page orchestration to the page entrypoint and aligning hook contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Page-level coordination behavior is moved from component modules to `backend/apps/clips/static/clips/js/pages/list-page.js` (drawer/sidebar wiring, cross-component orchestration, URL/panel synchronization, shared keyboard handling).
Component modules remain scoped to their own root and internal behavior.
Hook contracts touched in this refactor are standardized toward `data-action` / `data-role`.
Component template header comments include explicit `hooks` entries aligned with actual JS consumers.
Clips list interactions remain parity-equivalent after refactor.
notes: Migrated from `docs/plans/modular-front-end/code-review-findings.md` task `CRF-003`.

tasks.description: Establish the Stimulus migration inventory and define controller ownership boundaries for all currently interactive backend components.
acceptance_criteria: The in-scope interactive components are explicitly identified as `global-theme-toggle`, `global-auth-quick-search`, `clip-card`, `label-filter-options`, `filter-sidebar`, `filter-drawer`, and `filter-trigger-row` if the trigger remains outside the drawer root.
Each in-scope interaction is assigned to exactly one owning controller, with no remaining dependence on page-global orchestration or `window.*` controller APIs.
Cross-component coordination points are defined up front as either URL-state driven or DOM-event driven.
notes: Use this task as the implementation source of truth for controller boundaries and event contracts.

tasks.description: Introduce the backend Stimulus runtime, controller registry, and repeatable asset-loading path for server-rendered pages.
acceptance_criteria: A single backend JS application entrypoint starts Stimulus and registers all backend controllers.
The shared backend layout loads the Stimulus application entrypoint instead of per-component IIFE scripts.
Stimulus dependency installation/loading is represented through repository code and canonical workflow commands rather than ad hoc manual steps.
notes: Keep the solution minimal and compatible with the current Django static-file setup.

tasks.description: Refactor theme behavior into a `global-theme-toggle` Stimulus controller while preserving pre-paint theme restore semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Theme toggle connect/init, icon state, aria-label updates, and local-storage persistence are owned by a Stimulus controller attached to the theme component root.
Any required pre-paint theme restore remains in a minimal non-Stimulus bootstrap path so the current no-flash behavior is preserved.
The previous non-Stimulus theme controller implementation is removed or reduced to pre-paint restore only.
notes: Keep document theme state synchronized with the controller after connect.

tasks.description: Replace authenticated quick search with a `global-auth-quick-search` Stimulus controller using targets, values, and component-local event handling.
acceptance_criteria: Quick search input, panel, results list, and results-items container are modeled as Stimulus targets.
Debounce timing, endpoint, and query-length constraints are provided through controller values where appropriate.
Current quick-search behavior remains intact: request cancellation, results rendering, keyboard navigation, active descendant handling, escape close, and click-away close.
notes: Preserve IDs and accessibility attributes currently referenced by tests unless there is a strong reason to change them.

tasks.description: Convert `clip-card` delete behavior to a component-owned Stimulus controller and remove the legacy global initializer.
acceptance_criteria: Each clip card root owns its delete flow through a `clip-card` Stimulus controller.
CSRF handling, successful removal, and current failure messaging behavior remain unchanged.
The previous `window.ClipCardComponent` initializer is removed.
notes: Do not reintroduce page-level knowledge into clip-card behavior.

tasks.description: Convert label filtering behavior to Stimulus by introducing `label-filter-options`, `filter-sidebar`, `filter-drawer`, and `filter-trigger-row` controllers with explicit event contracts.
acceptance_criteria: `label-filter-options` owns label search, show-more, selected-state sync, row reordering, and URL mutation behavior through controller-local targets and methods.
`filter-sidebar` owns desktop panel expand/collapse state and URL `panel` synchronization.
`filter-drawer` owns mobile drawer open/close, backdrop, escape handling, focus management, and URL `panel` synchronization.
`filter-trigger-row` exists only if the drawer open trigger remains outside the drawer root; otherwise its responsibilities are collapsed into `filter-drawer` without breaking component boundaries.
No filtering behavior depends on `window.LabelFilterOptionsComponent`, `window.ClipsListLabelFilters`, or page-global orchestration.
notes: Use DOM events or URL state for coordination; avoid cross-controller DOM reach-through.

tasks.description: Remove clips list page orchestration and replace it with Stimulus controller coordination at component boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: `backend/apps/clips/static/clips/js/pages/list-page.js` is removed.
All former page-level orchestration responsibilities are reassigned to owning component controllers with explicit event or URL-state contracts.
Clips list interactions remain parity-equivalent on both desktop and mobile flows.
notes: This task is complete only when the page no longer acts as an interaction coordinator.

tasks.description: Update interactive component templates to use Stimulus controller, action, target, and value contracts while preserving existing component identity markers.
acceptance_criteria: Each interactive component root includes `data-controller` with the component identifier.
Internal behavioral hooks are expressed with Stimulus `data-action`, `data-<controller>-target`, and `data-<controller>-value` contracts.
Existing `data-component` root markers remain available where tests or component identity still depend on them.
Template changes preserve current accessibility attributes, semantic structure, and explicit include-context usage.
notes: Do not add no-op controllers to static components.

tasks.description: Remove superseded legacy scripts and global APIs after Stimulus replacements are fully wired.
acceptance_criteria: Legacy IIFE component scripts are removed or retired for `global-auth-quick-search`, `clip-card`, `label-filter-options`, and the clips list page.
Theme JavaScript is reduced to Stimulus-owned behavior plus any minimal pre-paint bootstrap needed before first paint.
Legacy global APIs (`window.ClipCardComponent`, `window.LabelFilterOptionsComponent`, `window.ClipsListLabelFilters`, and similar) are no longer present.
notes: Confirm there are no remaining template or test consumers before deleting any compatibility shims.

tasks.description: Update automated coverage for Stimulus contracts and interaction parity across backend-rendered components.
acceptance_criteria: Backend view/template tests are updated to assert the new Stimulus contracts on interactive components where those contracts matter.
Existing quick-search, filter, and clip interaction tests continue to validate behavior rather than implementation details.
Any new or updated browser/E2E coverage exercises quick search, filter sidebar/drawer behavior, label search/show-more/selection, clip delete flow, and theme toggle persistence.
notes: Preserve current coverage depth for accessibility-sensitive keyboard and focus behavior.

tasks.description: Run required verification gates and update plan artifacts to reflect the completed Stimulus migration work.
acceptance_criteria: Required backend checks pass for the refactor batch, including at minimum `make backend-test-unit`, `make backend-lint`, and `make backend-typecheck`.
The final release gate `make all-verify` passes before handoff.
Relevant plan artifacts under `docs/plans/modular-front-end/` reflect the final implementation status and any intentional follow-up debt.
notes: Do not run overlapping backend E2E commands in parallel with `make all-verify`.
